This network consists of a series of convolu- tional layers and max pooling operations, in which the spatial scale of the rep- resentation gradually decreases, but the number of channels gradually increases. The hidden layer after the last convolutional operation is resized to a 1D vector and three fully connected layers follow. The network outputs 1000 activations corresponding to the class labels that are passed through a softmax function to create class probabilities.
